column1: # The scenario registry - the one place a scenario is declared.
# run-e2e.sh used to carry the same list four times over: the per-series arrays, ALL_SCENARIOS, the
# SCENARIO_IDS map and the --only help text. Adding a scenario meant four edits, and the run order
# was whatever ALL_SCENARIOS happened to say rather than what the series arrays did.
#   id           Scenario id used in the report (S01.., D01.., B01..).
#   series       --only group this belongs to; also the milestone that introduced it.
#   controllers  Controllers the scenario needs. run-e2e.sh waits for these and skips the scenario
#                when one is unavailable, so a script no longer hand-rolls its own d-is-down check.
#   axis         What kind of coverage this is: function | data | time | scale
